stem.en: A dye is released in still water and spreads by diffusion alone. After one minute the blurred edge has moved about one millimetre from the source. Roughly how long until it has moved two millimetres?
stem.et: Värvainet lastakse seisvasse vette, kus see levib ainult difusiooni teel. Ühe minuti pärast on hägune serv liikunud allikast umbes ühe millimeetri kaugusele. Kui kaua kulub ligikaudu selleks, et see oleks liikunud kaks millimeetrit?

label.en: About four minutes, because the distance grows as the square root of the time
label.et: Umbes neli minutit, sest kaugus kasvab aja ruutjuurega

label.en: About two minutes, since the front advances at a steady speed set by how fast the molecules move
label.et: Umbes kaks minutit, sest serv liigub ühtlase kiirusega, mille määrab molekulide kiirus

label.en: It never gets there on its own: with zero average displacement the dye stays where it was put
label.et: Ise ta sinna ei jõuagi: kuna keskmine nihe on null, jääb värvaine sinna, kuhu ta pandi

label.en: The question cannot be answered, because the law describes each individual molecule's path and those are random
label.et: Küsimusele ei saa vastata, sest seadus kirjeldab iga üksiku molekuli teed ja need on juhuslikud
